description: Refactor, test, review, with rollback plan

tasks.task:
Analyze the code that needs refactoring for:

{{goal}}

Identify:
- Current structure and dependencies
- Coupling points and anti-patterns
- Test coverage gaps
- Performance bottlenecks

Refactor the code as described:

{{goal}}

Requirements:
- Preserve all existing behavior
- Improve code structure and readability
- Do NOT change public APIs without explicit approval
- Keep changes incremental and reviewable
acceptance_criteria: No public API changed without approval

tasks.task:
Add or update tests for the refactored code:

{{goal}}

- Fill test coverage gaps identified in the analysis phase
- Add regression tests for any edge cases discovered
- Ensure all tests (old and new) pass
acceptance_criteria: Test coverage meets or exceeds pre-refactor levels
Regression tests cover discovered edge cases

tasks.task:
Review the complete refactoring for:

{{goal}}

Verify:
- Behavior is preserved
- Tests are adequate
- No performance regressions
- Code is cleaner than before
